property_summary: After a successful payable addToBalance call, c.getBalance(sender) increases by exactly the amount sent and address(c).balance increases by the same amount.

For any sender and any msg.value, calling addToBalance always increases (or keeps) that sender's stored balance by exactly msg.value in the reference (i.e., getBalance(sender) after call equals old balance + msg.value); the mutant removing the overflow check can break this when addition overflows causing the stored balance to wrap and not equal old+msg.value.

For any sender and any msg.value, after calling addToBalance the stored balance equals the prior balance plus msg.value (no silent wrapping); the mutant (without the require) can overflow so the new stored balance != old + msg.value for some inputs.

For every caller and msg.value where the addition does not overflow (oldBalance + msg.value >= oldBalance), addToBalance succeeds and leaves getBalance(caller) == oldBalance + msg.value; the mutant (which omits the overflow check) allows cases where oldBalance + msg.value < oldBalance (i.e. overflow) causing the post-call balance to differ (wrap) and thus violating the relation.
